**Finding: deviation** (not missing) — Section 14 (¶p0048) does contain an insurance clause, but it under-delivers against the playbook.

What I found:
- **Compliant already:** workers' compensation as required by statute; certificates/evidence on request with notice of material change.
- **Gaps:** CGL stated at USD 1M with no aggregate; E&O at USD 1M vs. our USD 2M standard; **no cyber/privacy cover at all**, despite Contractor receiving Company Confidential Information including data and records (¶p0038), accessing Company computer systems and working at Company facilities (¶p0007). Coverage also ran only during the term, which is weak for claims-made E&O/cyber policies.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted at the **preferred** level: CGL 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O raised to 2M, cyber/privacy 5M where Contractor touches Company data or Confidential Information, coverage extended one year post-term, and "at its own expense" added. The comment offers the fallback (E&O 1M with cyber 2M) if RadialSpark's carrier cannot reach 5M.
